SHI_KONG_LIE_XI.pages.CAREFULLY.descript:
You listen intently.
The Earth.
[blue]300 million years ago[/blue], an era when giant beasts roamed freely, the birth of the milk frog’s ancestors… Fragmented images flood your mind.

[gold]Where do I come from?[/gold] you murmur to yourself.

When you snapped back to reality, the campfire had died down, and the elder and the tribe had vanished without a trace.

[green]Your stomach felt warm, as if something had settled deep inside you.[/green]
SHI_KONG_LIE_XI.pages.CASUALLY.descripti:
Just listen for now—think of it as a bedtime story.

The elder’s voice rises and falls, just like a lullaby, and your eyelids grow heavier and heavier…

When you wake up, the campfire has gone out, leaving only a patch of lukewarm ashes on the ground.

[green]Your wounds, however, have healed considerably.[/green]
SHI_KONG_LIE_XI.pages.INITIAL.descriptio:
Deep in the dense forest, you spot a faint glimmer of light in the distance.

As you draw closer, you discover a group of [gold]milk frogs[/gold] sitting around a campfire, gathered around an [sine]elderly figure[/sine]. The firelight illuminates his wrinkled face—he claims to be your ancestor from 300 million years ago.

He speaks in a language you’ve never heard before, as if it came from the depths of the earth:

“[sine]Ha—hahaha—ha—[/sine]”

Strangely enough, even though you don’t understand a single word, you vaguely grasp the meaning behind those sounds…
